title: Zero to First Agent: GitHub Copilot

cues.en: Hi, and welcome to this AI and C-Sharp video on how to get from zero to first agent using the GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Agent Framework.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支 C# AI 教學會示範，如何在 Microsoft Agent Framework 中使用 GitHub Copilot，從零建立第一個代理程式。

cues.en: Because in the past, we have made a bunch of agents, but we have always gone through the various APIs of OpenAI,
cues.zh: 過去建立了許多代理程式，但一直都是透過 OpenAI、

cues.en: Google, and so on, through either OpenRouter directly or Azure.
cues.zh: Google 等 API，直接使用、經由 OpenRouter，或透過 Azure 連接。

cues.en: But you can actually also use your GitHub Copilot in order to make calls to Agent Framework
cues.zh: 但其實也能使用 GitHub Copilot，在 Agent Framework 中發出呼叫，

cues.en: by only having a subscription, so you don't actually need to pay for token cost.
cues.zh: 只需要訂閱，不必另外按 Token 支付 API 費用。

cues.en: You pay by having a GitHub Copilot, of course.
cues.zh: 當然，仍然需要支付 GitHub Copilot 訂閱費。

cues.en: So this is a different way, and in order to do that, let's go see some code.
cues.zh: 這是另一種方式，接著看程式碼。

cues.en: So here I am in my sample repo, and I have a GitHub Copilot local here.
cues.zh: 範例儲存庫中，這裡有 GitHub Copilot Local。

cues.en: And I'm just going to close all of these, and we are going to go in and see that we have an empty thing here.
cues.zh: 先關掉這些檔案，可以看到目前主程式是空的。

cues.en: I have a little tool that we were going to use later on, but else I have not really done anything here.
cues.zh: 只有稍後會使用的一個小工具，其他都還沒做。

cues.en: Now a few steps we need to go through.
cues.zh: 需要完成幾個步驟。

cues.en: The first thing is to have that your machine can talk with GitHub, so it knows that you are who you are, and if you have a GitHub subscription or not.
cues.zh: 首先，要讓電腦能夠向 GitHub 驗證身分，確認你是誰，以及是否具有 GitHub，

cues.en: The Copilot part.
cues.zh: Copilot 的訂閱。

cues.en: And that can either be done using the GitHub CLI, and you can see I'm logged in here already, so I already have access.
cues.zh: 可以透過 GitHub CLI 完成。這裡已經登入，所以已具備存取權。

cues.en: But we can also do it using a token, which we'll see at the end.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 Token，影片最後會介紹。

cues.en: The first thing we need to do is we need to install the Microsoft Agent Framework, and specifically their GitHub Copilot package,
cues.zh: 接著安裝 Microsoft Agent Framework，具體來說是它的 GitHub Copilot 套件，

cues.en: so we can work with the GitHub Copilot NuGet package that is behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 它會使用背後的 GitHub Copilot NuGet 套件。

cues.en: So let's go in and install that as a NuGet package.
cues.zh: 先安裝這個 NuGet 套件。

cues.en: There we go. We should now have access to it.
cues.zh: 好了，現在應該可以使用。

cues.en: So the first thing we need to do is we're going to need to build up the role local provider,
cues.zh: 首先建立底層的本機 Provider，

cues.en: just like we normally do when we make an OpenAI client and then make an agent on top of that.
cues.zh: 就像平常先建立 OpenAIClient，再在上面建立代理程式。

cues.en: In this case, it's called a Copilot client.
cues.zh: 這裡稱為 CopilotClient。

cues.en: So if we make one of these, we can make a client, and as you can see here, we have extra options.
cues.zh: 建立實例時，可以看到還有額外選項。

cues.en: We will look at them a little later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會介紹。

cues.en: But out of the box, we can just take the default.
cues.zh: 但基本使用直接採預設即可。

cues.en: And since this is a persistent client, we need to do an await using on this one
cues.zh: 因為這是一個持續運作的用戶端，因此要使用 await using，

cues.en: in order for whenever it goes out of scope that we actually close down the client again.
cues.zh: 確保離開作用範圍時，會關閉用戶端。

cues.en: Once we have the clients, we need to start it, which is a little different from the other things because the other things have really just been an API
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，需要啟動它。這和其他版本有點不同，因為其他都是一般 API，

cues.en: where we did request response.
cues.zh: 以請求、回應方式運作。

cues.en: Here we are actually using an executable behind the scenes in order to do this.
cues.zh: 這裡背後實際會使用可執行檔。

cues.en: I don't have the GitHub Copilot installed in any way.
cues.zh: 我並沒有另外安裝 GitHub Copilot。

cues.en: So if I go here and write Copilot, you can see I don't have that installed.
cues.zh: 在這裡輸入 copilot，就會看到沒有安裝。

cues.en: So it actually comes with the executable behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 因為套件本身已經附帶所需的可執行檔。

cues.en: So you don't need to install that.
cues.zh: 所以不需要額外安裝。

cues.en: That also means it can work up and deploy it in Azure if need be. So that's nice.
cues.zh: 這也表示有需要時，可以部署到 Azure 執行，很方便。

cues.en: Once we have the clients, we can simply just say, as AI agent.
cues.zh: 取得用戶端後，直接呼叫 AsAIAgent。

cues.en: But instead of the normal, we can simply just say, as AI agent.
cues.zh: 同樣是使用 AsAIAgent，

cues.en: But instead of the normal configuration object, we have something called a session config
cues.zh: 但不是傳入一般設定物件，而是 SessionConfig，

cues.en: because this uses a bunch of other configurations than a normal Microsoft agent client that we have seen before.
cues.zh: 因為它使用的設定，和前面那些一般 Agent 用戶端有很大差異。

cues.en: But we're going to make one of these session configs.
cues.zh: 因此先建立 SessionConfig。

cues.en: And inside this, there is a bunch of settings, as you can see.
cues.zh: 可以看到裡面有許多設定。

cues.en: And we don't really need to set too much of them.
cues.zh: 其實不需要設定太多。

cues.en: We need to set the model of what model we want to work with.
cues.zh: 需要指定想使用的模型。

cues.en: So we're going to use dbt61-sol.
cues.zh: 這裡示範使用 GPT-6.1 sol。

cues.en: But it of course depends on which of the models you have access to.
cues.zh: 當然，實際取決於帳號可以使用哪些模型。

cues.en: We can set a working directory, just like we would in a GitHub Copilot.
cues.zh: 也可以設定工作目錄，就像使用 GitHub Copilot 一樣。

cues.en: Say we're working in this directory, this is my repository.
cues.zh: 指定目前要在這個目錄工作，這是我的儲存庫。

cues.en: And if we don't set it, it will just be the same as what I write in environment.q and directory.
cues.zh: 如果不設定，就會使用 Environment.CurrentDirectory 的位置。

cues.en: But you should definitely set a directory model.
cues.zh: 不過模型與工作目錄都建議明確設定。

cues.en: This one will be able to pick up whatever configurations you have for GitHub Copilot on your machine, meaning if you go into the GitHub Copilot CLI
cues.zh: 它會讀取電腦上 GitHub Copilot 的設定。例如在 GitHub Copilot CLI 中，

cues.en: and set up an MCP server, it will pick up that MCP server.
cues.zh: 設定了 MCP 伺服器，它也會一併載入。

cues.en: It will pick up the plugins you put in there.
cues.zh: 也會載入安裝的外掛。

cues.en: All of this can else be set here, so we can set MCP servers and all kinds of things here.
cues.zh: 這些內容同樣能在這裡設定，包括 MCP 伺服器等各種選項。

cues.en: In our case, we are not going to do too much.
cues.zh: 這個例子不會設定太多。

cues.en: We're just going to say we want tools.
cues.zh: 只要提供工具。

cues.en: So let's get an AI function factory, because we can call C Sharp generated tools here.
cues.zh: 透過 AIFunctionFactory 建立，因為這裡能呼叫以 C# 定義的工具。

cues.en: That's why I have to get weather tool.
cues.zh: 這就是前面準備 GetWeather 工具的原因。

cues.en: And we're just going to call it get weather.
cues.zh: 直接把 GetWeather 加入。

cues.en: In order to use these tools, however, we need to set some permissions.
cues.zh: 但要使用這些工具，還需要設定權限。

cues.en: So we can say on permission requests and say permission handler dot approval.
cues.zh: 設定 OnPermissionRequest，使用 PermissionHandler.ApproveAll。

cues.en: Else it would not be able to call these tools, or you would need to go in and react to a permission as being set.
cues.zh: 否則它無法直接呼叫工具，或是你必須另外處理權限要求。

cues.en: But that's beyond our scope.
cues.zh: 那超出了這個範例的範圍。

cues.en: I'm just going to approve everything here.
cues.zh: 這裡為了示範，直接核准全部。

cues.en: Again, most of this is not needed if we don't want to have extra tools or anything.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，如果不需要額外工具，這裡大部分設定都不必要。

cues.en: But again, you can set a lot of things in here.
cues.zh: 不過這裡確實能設定很多東西。

cues.en: One of the other things you can set in here is actually a cloud where you could actually set up your own cloud.
cues.zh: 另一項設定是雲端，可以設定自己的雲端環境，

cues.en: Where you could actually spin it up and run cloud sessions.
cues.zh: 建立並執行雲端 Session。

cues.en: But as of this recording, there's a bug in the underlying.
cues.zh: 但在錄影當下，底層的，

cues.en: You get package that so I can't show that.
cues.zh: NuGet 套件有錯誤，因此無法示範。

cues.en: So that will be for another video.
cues.zh: 這部分會留到另一支影片。

cues.en: But now that we have our agents, we can do what we normally do.
cues.zh: 取得代理程式後，就能做平常的操作。

cues.en: So instead of me just sitting and writing, I will just paste that in here.
cues.zh: 我就直接貼上，不逐字輸入。

cues.en: So we can say what's the capital of France.
cues.zh: 可以問：法國的首都是哪裡？

cues.en: And in order to use the weather tool, we can say and how's the weather in this capital.
cues.zh: 為了使用天氣工具，再問：那個首都的天氣如何？

cues.en: And I'm going to put in here that use the tool get weather.
cues.zh: 我也會明確要求使用 GetWeather 工具。

cues.en: Because behind the scenes, these copilots have already have automatic web search and all kinds of extra tools that can help.
cues.zh: 因為這些 Copilot 在背後已經有自動網頁搜尋，以及其他輔助工具。

cues.en: And if I don't specify it, I often see that it will just begin to do, find the real weather instead of me just showing you that you can call this.
cues.zh: 如果不明確指定，我經常看到它直接查詢真實天氣，而不是呼叫這個示範工具。

cues.en: So we're just making a question. I'm writing it out here.
cues.zh: 所以先準備問題，並在這裡輸出。

cues.en: And then we're doing the normal agent dot run async.
cues.zh: 接著正常呼叫 agent.RunAsync。

cues.en: We get a response back and we save it.
cues.zh: 取得回應並保存。

cues.en: And in the same manner, we can also, of course, do stream.
cues.zh: 同樣地，當然也可以使用串流。

cues.en: Just like we've seen all the other ones.
cues.zh: 就像前面所有例子一樣。

cues.en: So we can say agent dot run streaming async of a question, for example, how to make soup.
cues.zh: 例如呼叫 agent.RunStreamingAsync，詢問如何煮湯。

cues.en: And then instead of just getting one response back, we await for each word back so we can write them out.
cues.zh: 不是一次取得完整回應，而是使用 await foreach，逐步輸出回傳的文字。

cues.en: In most other cases, we can actually use the third option on an AI agent called run async to do structured output.
cues.zh: 在其他多數情況，AIAgent 還能用第三種泛型 RunAsync，取得結構化輸出。

cues.en: But unfortunately, GitHub profile can't support that.
cues.zh: 但很可惜，GitHub Copilot 不支援。

cues.en: So if you need that, which you unfortunately need in many cases, it is unfortunately not possible for us to use that.
cues.zh: 因此如果需要結構化輸出，而很多情況確實需要，就無法透過這個方式使用。

cues.en: But let's have a look and see how this works.
cues.zh: 接著實際看看運作。

cues.en: So I'll just set a breakpoint and we will go to, so we make our client and we start that client.
cues.zh: 先設中斷點，建立用戶端並啟動。

cues.en: We make our agents and we're going to ask our question.
cues.zh: 建立代理程式，接著提出問題。

cues.en: So over here, you can see the question and you should be able to see the answer back.
cues.zh: 這邊可以看到問題，稍後應該也能看到答案。

cues.en: Let me do this so we can see them side by side.
cues.zh: 調整一下，方便並排觀看。

cues.en: More room over here.
cues.zh: 這邊多留一點空間。

cues.en: So we can see that it now called our weather tool.
cues.zh: 可以看到現在呼叫了天氣工具。

cues.en: So we hit our breakpoint.
cues.zh: 命中中斷點了。

cues.en: I'll just get rid of the breakpoint so we can continue.
cues.zh: 先移除中斷點，繼續執行。

cues.en: And it will come back with its response.
cues.zh: 接著會回傳答案。

cues.en: And that is Paris, and it's 19 degrees and sunny there.
cues.zh: 也就是巴黎，當地晴天、19 度。

cues.en: And the same manner for streaming.
cues.zh: 串流的做法也相同。

cues.en: Again, after we have our agent, everything works just the same as before, with the only caveat that we can't use to run async
cues.zh: 建立代理程式後，其餘都和之前一樣，唯一限制是無法使用泛型 RunAsync，

cues.en: for structured output, which is a real shame.
cues.zh: 取得結構化輸出，這真的很可惜。

cues.en: So in this case, I'm just hooking up to, I'm logged in to GitHub.
cues.zh: 這個例子是因為我已經登入 GitHub，

cues.en: So it will just figure it out.
cues.zh: 因此它會自動取得身分。

cues.en: But what if you want to run this in a place where you don't want to log in, but you want to use a token in order to be a user yourself
cues.zh: 但如果要在不想登入的環境執行，希望透過 Token 代表自己，

cues.en: or some automated user?
cues.zh: 或某個自動化帳號呢？

cues.en: In such a case, you need to go to the options here.
cues.zh: 這種情況，要到這裡的選項。

cues.en: And you're going to say, see it's used logged in user.
cues.zh: 可以看到 UseLoggedInUser，

cues.en: And we're going to say false.
cues.zh: 把它設為 false。

cues.en: And if we do that and just run it again,
cues.zh: 只改這個設定再執行，

cues.en: we will now see that we are not authenticated.
cues.zh: 就會看到目前沒有通過驗證。

cues.en: So the second we try to call, it will actually fail that it has no authentication token.
cues.zh: 因此一發出呼叫，就會因為沒有認證 Token 而失敗。

cues.en: And the token, we can go in and actually create.
cues.zh: Token 可以自行建立。

cues.en: So let me go to GitHub.
cues.zh: 前往 GitHub。

cues.en: And there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: And I already have a token that can do this, but I'm going to generate a new token just so we can see how those tokens look like.
cues.zh: 我已經有可使用的 Token，但還是新建一個，讓你看看設定過程。

cues.en: In real life, I'm going to delete that token after the fact.
cues.zh: 實際上，示範完成後就會刪除這個 Token。

cues.en: So we're just going to do a GH test here.
cues.zh: 這裡命名為 GH Test。

cues.en: I will give it seven days, but I will have deleted it.
cues.zh: 有效期設為七天，但我會刪除。

cues.en: I will give it seven days, but I will have deleted it once you see this video.
cues.zh: 雖然設七天，但你看到影片時，它已經被刪除了。

cues.en: We can give it access to repositories if we want to.
cues.zh: 有需要也能給它儲存庫存取權。

cues.en: And we can give it access.
cues.zh: 接著設定權限。

cues.en: And if we search for Copilot here, we need to give it access to do Copilot requests.
cues.zh: 搜尋 Copilot，需要給它發出 Copilot Requests 的權限。

cues.en: So if we do that, we generate a token.
cues.zh: 完成後，產生 Token。

cues.en: And that token, I will grab here and put in here.
cues.zh: 取得這個 Token，放到這裡。

cues.en: In real life, you should, of course, put it in environment variables, secrets, or keywords.
cues.zh: 實際使用時，當然應該放在環境變數、Secrets 或 Key Vault。

cues.en: But if we do that, we can then go in and give the token here.
cues.zh: 設定好後，就能在這裡提供 Token。

cues.en: And now this code will not use my logged-in credentials on the machine.
cues.zh: 現在程式不會使用電腦上已登入的認證資訊。

cues.en: So I can ship this code with the credentials, and it would work anywhere in the world, as we can see over here.
cues.zh: 因此在其他執行環境提供同樣的認證，就能運作，這裡可以看到結果。

cues.en: So there's the both options.
cues.zh: 這就是兩種選項。

cues.en: All depending, if you're making a local program, you can, of course, just say, hey, user, please log in before you use it.
cues.zh: 如果是本機程式，可以要求使用者先登入。

cues.en: If it's need to run in a cloud, you need to use tokens just like an API token.
cues.zh: 如果需要在雲端執行，就使用 Token，類似一般 API Token。

cues.en: And of course, this will use your GitHub Copilot subscription in the way you have that set up.
cues.zh: 當然，這仍然會依照你的設定，使用 GitHub Copilot 訂閱額度。

cues.en: So if you run out of limits or credits or however it's set up, it will, of course, also stop to work just like an API keyword.
cues.zh: 所以如果用完限制、點數或其他配額，也會和 API 金鑰一樣停止運作。

cues.en: So this is actually everything that is to it in order to go in and run Copilot using Microsoft 18 Framework.
cues.zh: 以上就是透過 Microsoft Agent Framework 執行 Copilot 的完整做法。

cues.en: Again, there's a bunch of extra settings.
cues.zh: 同樣地，還有很多額外設定。

cues.en: But the cool thing is, of course, that you out of the box get what a real coding harness would be able to do instead of needing to set up every single little thing.
cues.zh: 最棒的是，一開始就取得真正程式開發代理環境的能力，不必自行設定每個細節。

cues.en: Because this one can, of course, go in and work with the file system and the folder system because the GitHub Copilot client have these tools out of the box.
cues.zh: 因為 GitHub Copilot 用戶端原本就有檔案系統與資料夾操作工具，可以直接使用。

cues.en: But that's everything from my side here.
cues.zh: 這次想介紹的就是這些。

cues.en: See you on the next one.
cues.zh: 下一支影片見。
